review.note: Retracted in M22: a robbery of the Banco Borges & Irmão at Monte dos Burgos, Porto, on 4 November 1977 by five members of the PRP-BR, which took 400,000 escudos. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Robbery of Banco Borges & Irmão, in Monte dos Burgos, Porto, November 4, 1977
